Exercise: Medicine Ball Full Twist

Category:
plyometrics

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- rotational

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- shoulders

Equipment:

- medicine_ball

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:
None

Contraindications:

- condition: Lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Medicine Ball Side Twist, force: pull, level: beginner, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['abdominals'], secondaryMuscles: ['shoulders']

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Medicine Ball Russian Twist, equipment: medicine ball

Instructions:

- For this exercise you will need a medicine ball and a partner. Stand back to back with your partner, spaced 2-3 feet apart. This will be your starting position.
- Hold the ball in front of the trunk. Open the hips and turn the shoulders at the same time as your partner.
- For full rotation, you and your partner should twist in the same direction, i.e. counter-clockwise.
- Pass the ball to your partner, and both of you can now twist in the opposite direction to repeat the procedure.
